items.prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
items.correct: AI is the capability of computational systems to perform tasks associated with human intelligence and a research field developing methods to do so.
wrongs: AI is a single software program invented in 2020.
AI research ignores mathematics and engineering.
AI can only play board games.
why: The text defines AI as a capability and a field of research.
The text says the field was founded as an academic discipline in 1956.
The text says the field spans computer science, engineering, and mathematics.
items.explanation: The passage defines AI, describes its research goals and techniques, and lists applications.

items.prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?
items.append: Because artificial general intelligence is defined as AI that can complete nearly any cognitive task at least as well as a human, AGI most likely ______
items.correct: would be more general than task-specific systems.
wrongs: would excel at only one game.
would require no computation.
would be limited to image generation.
why: Nearly any cognitive task implies broad capability beyond a single domain.
A single game is a narrow task.
AGI is still computational.
items.explanation: The definition's breadth contrasts with narrow, task-specific AI.

items.prompt: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
items.correct: It defines AI, describes its research goals and techniques, and lists applications, companies, and its founding.
wrongs: It explains how to train a neural network step by step.
It compares AI with human biology in detail.
It argues that AGI already exists.
why: No training procedure is given.
Biology is mentioned only as an influence.
The text says some companies aim to create AGI, not that it exists.
items.explanation: The passage moves from definition and research to applications and history.

items.prompt: Which quotation from the text most directly supports the claim that AI performs cognitive tasks?
items.correct: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the capability of computational systems to perform tasks typically associated with human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, problem-solving, perception, and decision-making.
wrongs: It is also a field of research spanning computer science, engineering, and mathematics.
Prominent applications of AI include advanced web search engines, chatbots, virtual assistants, and autonomous vehicles.
Artificial intelligence was founded as an academic discipline in 1956.
why: This sentence describes the research field.
This sentence lists applications.
This sentence dates the discipline's founding.
items.explanation: The correct quotation names learning, reasoning, problem-solving, perception, and decision-making.

items.prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
items.correct: Machine learning develops statistical algorithms that learn from data and generalize to unseen data without explicit programming.
wrongs: Machine learning requires every rule to be programmed by hand.
Machine learning is unrelated to statistics.
Machine learning and artificial intelligence are exactly synonymous.
why: The text defines ML as algorithms that learn from data and generalize.
The text says they perform tasks without being explicitly programmed.
The text says statistics and mathematical optimisation compose its foundations.
items.explanation: The passage defines machine learning, describes its foundations, and explains its relationship to AI.

items.prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?
items.append: Because machine learning algorithms generalize to unseen data, they most likely ______
items.correct: can handle new examples beyond their training data.
wrongs: memorize only their training examples.
cannot make predictions.
require no data at all.
why: Generalization means applying learned patterns to new data.
Memorization would not generalize.
The text says ML performs tasks such as prediction.
items.explanation: Generalization is the ability to perform well on data not seen during training.

items.prompt: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?
items.correct: It defines machine learning, describes its foundations and theory, and explains its rise and naming.

items.prompt: Which quotation from the text most directly supports the claim that machine learning works without explicit programming?
items.correct: Machine learning (ML) is a field of study in artificial intelligence concerned with the development and study of statistical algorithms that can learn from data and generalize to unseen data, and thus perform tasks without being explicitly programmed.
wrongs: Statistics and mathematical optimisation methods compose the foundations of machine learning.

why: This sentence describes ML's foundations.

items.explanation: The correct quotation explicitly says tasks are performed without being explicitly programmed.

items.prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

why: The text describes techniques for secure communication against adversaries.
The text says it prevents third parties from reading private messages.

items.explanation: The passage defines cryptography, describes its core concepts and applications, and contrasts modern with pre-modern practice.

items.prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?
items.append: Because the sender shares the decryption technique only with intended recipients, an eavesdropper most likely ______
items.correct: cannot read the message.

can read the plaintext easily.
is one of the intended recipients.
why: Sharing the technique only with recipients excludes the eavesdropper.

items.explanation: Excluding adversaries from the decryption method keeps the message unreadable to them.

items.prompt: Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

wrongs: Cryptography is the practice and study of techniques for secure communication in the presence of adversarial behavior.

why: This sentence defines cryptography.

This sentence lists applications.
items.explanation: The correct quotation says cryptography prevents third parties from reading private messages.

items.prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
